rationale:
The subject has three obligations. Both constructors must use the supplied language regardless of the filename extension. Both must return root contents. The value must retain the language's fingerprinting scheme.

The marked test `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/outline_content.rs#fn[explicit_languages_share_configuration_and_retain_their_scheme]` covers all three:

- **Extension ignored:** `CustomLanguage` declares the extension `custom`, but both `from_source_with` and `from_path_with` are called on a file named `misleading.rs`. The test asserts the outline span `Span::new(0, 9)` and fingerprint scheme `custom-v2` for both results. An implementation that chose a language by extension would produce a different outline or scheme, so the test would fail.
- **Root contents:** For both the `from_path_with` result (`loaded`) and the `from_source_with` result (`supplied`), the test asserts an empty selector `""`, the full text `a hello z`, and a root outline item spanning the whole text.
- **Scheme retained:** The test asserts the root fingerprint has scheme `custom-v2` and value `a hello z`. It then drops the language, its clone and the `Arc` configuration, and still asserts `supplied.fingerprint_scheme()` is `custom-v2`, so the value does not depend on the language staying alive. A second language with scheme `custom-v3` gives the same structural hash but a different fingerprint, so the scheme is part of the fingerprint. Selecting `part[selected]` gives the expected text and structural hash.

The path-loaded and source-supplied values are compared and agree. This is relevant to the cited `snapshot` requirement, which the same test also marks.

The error cases for explicit languages are handled in a separate test, `explicit_language_errors_and_invalid_spans_are_not_plain_text_successes`, and belong to the `errors` requirement, not this one. I found no unacknowledged gap.

text: The caller can supply an `OutlineLang` explicitly when loading a file or
outlining supplied text. These constructors use that language regardless of
the filename's extension and return root contents. The value retains that
An `OutlineContent` retains the source text, outline, and selected language's
fingerprinting scheme describing that same snapshot. Its item spans, selected
text, and structural hashes are derived from those bytes. A cached value keeps
these parts together; later file edits do not change the loaded value.
